name: traces_dependency_error_rate_high
title: Downstream dependency error rate above 10%
description: Client and producer spans from a service to one downstream dependency (the server_address it calls) failed more than 10% of the time in the last 10 minutes, with at least 50 calls. All operations to the same dependency are counted together, so one failing database, cache or API shows as one row. Spans without server_address are grouped under an empty dependency. Needs OpenTelemetry traces in the traces stream named default.

query_condition.sql: SELECT service_name, server_address AS dependency, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS error_pct FROM "default" WHERE span_kind IN ('3', '4') GROUP BY service_name, server_address HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 AND SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 10
